_comment: Permissible deviations per guideline interval. Draft values - not the official HPT guideline.
_bands_comment: Interval H carries its own individual half-widths here: db_k, wb_k, flow_instantaneous_pct and dtreturn_k. Equilibrium and evaluation reuse the H keys for DB / WB / flow and keep their own dtreturn_k, so there is deliberately no second H table. Nothing in this file points at flask_app/permissible_deviations.json any more: saving Configure Deviation Bands edits the full-cycle parent Deviations tolerances only, and must not retune Guideline Windows interval % or the Deviations Plot interval steps.
_dtreturn_comment: dtreturn_k is the individual liquid sink INLET half-width in K: dTreturn = T_return_emu - T_return_calc, measured return minus set return. Interval H is +/-0.5 K and equilibrium and evaluation carry the same +/-0.5 K. The parent Deviations page keeps its own full-cycle band (-2...+2 K) in permissible_deviations.json. An interval without dtreturn_k is shown as n/a, never as 0 %.
_ds_comment: Interval D and S individual half-widths from the draft transient table (air-to-water). Encode only filled cells: a missing key is n/a, never 0. Do not copy the Interval H keys onto D or S - that would score them with the +/-1 K of H.
_mean_comment: mean_* keys are the MEAN half-widths of the draft transient table: one arithmetic mean per interval against its setpoint, not a share of samples. Guideline Windows scores them as H / D / S mean columns (K, or % of set for flow). They are a different quantity from the individual widths above, so H mean DB is +/-0.3 K while H individual DB stays +/-1 K, and they must not be copied onto the parent Deviations page (mean DB there stays 0.6 K). A draft cell that is - or ? has no key here and stays n/a: D has no mean Tsup / flow / inlet, S has no mean Tsup / inlet, and Tmean is undecided on H, D and S.
